page_title: PSG 5-2 MON | PSG v Monaco 24/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's it for today, Benoit Bastien has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+6' 5 - 2 Goal! Randal Kolo Muani (PSG) fires the rebound into the bottom right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 5:2.
90+6' PSG take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
90+6' The defender bravely blocks the shot from Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the box.
90+5' We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 10:7.
90+3' Achraf Hakimi (PSG) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' A dangerous towering header by Denis Zakaria (Monaco) from around the penalty spot goes just wide of the left post. This corner kick didn't change the score.
90' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.

89' Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco) latches on to a precise pass and finds himself one-on-one with the keeper. He fires a low shot towards the left side of the net, but Gianluigi Donnarumma leaps like a salmon to deny him.
88' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
86' The resulting set piece from Monaco is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
85' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) sets himself up on the edge of the box, but balloons his shot way over the bar.
84' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Monaco comes to nothing.
82' Luis Enrique decides to make a substitution. Fabian Ruiz will be replaced by Carlos Soler (PSG).
81' Ismail Jakobs (Monaco) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety.
79' The substitution has been made. Krepin Diatta (Monaco) has replaced Vanderson.
79' A substitution has been made. Mohamed Camara is replaced by Wissam Ben Yedder (Monaco).
79' Here is a change. Takumi Minamino is going off and Adi Hutter gives the last tactical orders to Maghnes Akliouche (Monaco).
75' 4 - 2 Goal - 4:2! Takumi Minamino tees up Folarin Balogun (Monaco) inside the box and he rolls the ball into the bottom left corner and past Gianluigi Donnarumma.
72' 4 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe plays a short, square pass into the path of Vitinha (PSG), who bends a shot straight into the top right corner to make it 4:1. Fabulous goal!
72' It's time for a substitution. Bradley Barcola (PSG) comes on in place of Ousmane Dembele.
71' Luis Enrique prepares a substitution. Goncalo Ramos is replaced by Randal Kolo Muani (PSG).

70' 3 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Ousmane Dembele (PSG) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
70' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.
69' Manuel Ugarte (PSG) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
68' Monaco failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
65' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Monaco.
64' The corner is swung in but Monaco can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
59' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
58' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
57' Monaco seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
54' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) and Achraf Hakimi attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
52' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
52' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) picks up an injury.
50' The goalkeeper pulls off a save to deny Ousmane Dembele (PSG), whose effort is only aimed at the middle of the goal.

47' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) receives a precise low pass inside the box, controls the ball and releases it under the roof. Unfortunately for him, Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a great save to stop his effort.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+5' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.

45' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom right corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
44' Nordi Mukiele (PSG) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
42' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
39' 2 - 1 Goal! Kylian Mbappe (PSG) puts the ball into the roof of the net past the outstretched arm of Philipp Kohn.
38' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) is going to take the penalty!
37' Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco) commits a rough challenge and Benoit Bastien blows his whistle for an infringement. The referee gives a penalty kick to PSG!!
37' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Takumi Minamino (Monaco) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
36' Ousmane Dembele (PSG) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.

33' A defence-splitting pass is taken in his stride by Kylian Mbappe (PSG) in the box. Without even looking up he drills a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Philipp Kohn pulls off a brilliant save.
31' Denis Zakaria (Monaco) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
30' Wilfried Singo (Monaco) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Benoit Bastien saw the whole situation.
28' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) produces a lovely chip pass into the box, but one of the opposition players cuts it out.
27' Takumi Minamino (Monaco) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Gianluigi Donnarumma has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
24' Foul! Lucas Hernandez (PSG) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
22' 1 - 1 Goal! Gianluigi Donnarumma makes a huge mistake and Takumi Minamino (Monaco) has an easy task to put the ball into the back of the net. 1:1.
21' Folarin Balogun (Monaco) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
18' 1 - 0 Goal! Goncalo Ramos (PSG) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball low into the middle of the net. It's 1:0.
18' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) sends a lofted cross into the box which is headed clear.
17' PSG can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
15' The goal by Monaco is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
14' That looked like an offside in the build-up play and the referee Benoit Bastien is going to take a look using VAR.
14' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Vanderson (Monaco) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
12' Monaco have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
12' The corner is flicked onto Soungoutou Magassa (Monaco), but his close-range header flies just over the bar.
11' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) is about to take a corner kick.
8' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads inside the right post, but Philipp Kohn shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
7' Aleksandr Golovin (Monaco) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

7' What a great touch by Takumi Minamino (Monaco) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending. The ball goes out of play and Monaco have been awarded a corner kick.
6' Goncalo Ramos (PSG) unleashes a decent shot towards the roof of the net, but Philipp Kohn thwarts him with a nice save.
4' Kylian Mbappe (PSG) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
2' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Kylian Mbappe (PSG) offside.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are out and the match is about to start. PSG will have the kick-off.
Benoit Bastien was nominated as the referee for this game.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
